summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. furnished a Form 6-K containing a London Stock Exchange announcement of a PDMR shareholding, disclosing a grant of 5,246 ordinary shares of EUR3.50 each to Chief Supply Chain and Operations Officer Sandeep Desai on 21-SEP-2026 under the 2026 Performance Share Plan, valued using a GBP14.30 reference price (approximately GBP75,013). The award reflects an expanded role covering Operations, carries pre-set performance conditions plus malus and clawback provisions, and was priced off the 14-18 September 2026 LSE average close. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or change of control is involved; a routine compensation disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
